decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the car has been changed while under Parc Fermé.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The setup was modified whilst the car was in Parc Fermé with the approval of the Technical Delegate. The parts have been changed for a different specification. The car is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
